killedBy: stepMultiset builds a list with repeats, which is what the parser takes
why: The whole point of a MULTISET: `sandboxTanks` keeps repeats, so three brown tanks is `brown,brown,brown` and not `brown`. Collapsing to a set silently caps every kind at one, and a sandbox asked for three enemies gets one with no note anywhere -- the parser accepts both strings, so nothing else in the model objects.
